articles.title: Google–PLDT deploy ‘air laser’ internet to island barangay, bypassing cables entirely
articles.summary: PLDT and Google's Taara project successfully delivered fiber-like internet to Barangay Subay in Talim Island, Rizal. This innovative initiative bypassed the need for traditional underwater cables, employing a new system to bridge the connectivity gap. The project demonstrates a significant advancement in bringing high-speed internet to remote or challenging locations, showcasing technological solutions for last-mile connectivity without extensive infrastructure.

articles.title: Parag Parikh Flexi Cap Fund: ITC, MCX among stocks bought and sold in January
articles.summary: Parag Parikh Flexi Cap Fund, India's largest active and flexicap fund by assets under management (AUM), reported an AUM of Rs 1,33,969 crore in January 2026. This figure underscores its dominant position in the financial market and indicates substantial growth. The fund's performance is a key indicator of investor confidence and trends within the national financial landscape, reflecting broader economic activity.
